network.counting_scope: Base, fault and schema ledgers have separate denominators; do not sum them as one unique request count.

limits: real loopback SeaweedFS 4.51 is not AWS Standard acceptance
cache removal is a source-bound controller stat/rmtree observation, not external filesystem attestation
valid foreign named hash collisions are not manufactured; direct foreign identities and invalid provenance are separate
no general all-stage 403/5xx matrix, namespace inventory, garbage collection or operational SLO claim

cleanup.four_worker_suites: No cleanup/proxy errors in original network, retained, lifecycle or catalogue summary.
cleanup.scope: Original fault-injection ledgers include intended SIGKILL and replacement; no claim that every child exited normally.

boundaries.actual_interface: Rust worker/example with actual TCP and signed local S3-compatible backend. These are not ordinary /v1 HTTP service RPC counts.
boundaries.catalogue_http_statuses: These status counts describe the signed object-store backend, not user-facing HTTP.
boundaries.new_encoder_or_output_pool_acceptance: NOT_RUN; these results bind only runtime778.

prior_failures: Original 052 fmt, release-attempt01 precondition, 4329 discovery and 3ca metadata observer failures retain their original source identities and statuses.
